commands.command: WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{if(document.body.innerText.includes("What do you want to do?")){const b=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(x=>x.innerText.includes("Control temperature"));if(!b)throw new Error("temperature button missing");b.click();return "opened-temperature";}return "already-deep";})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){if(m.result.exceptionDetails)process.exit(1);console.log(m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}' && sleep 1

WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{if(!document.body.innerText.includes("No plugs added."))return "already-added";const inputs=[...document.querySelectorAll("input")];const url=inputs.find(e=>e.type==="url");if(!url)throw new Error("url input missing");const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,"value").set;set.call(url,"http://192.168.0.16/");url.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true}));url.dispatchEvent(new Event("change",{bubbles:true}));const b=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==="Add");if(!b)throw new Error("Add submit missing");b.click();return "submitted";})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){if(m.result.exceptionDetails){console.error(JSON.stringify(m.result.exceptionDetails));process.exit(1)}console.log(m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}' && sleep 4
